items.title: [AINews] Riemann Hypothesis proved...twice independently

items.description: November 20 2026 —
items.summary: Within a few hours of each other ( timeline ), two mathematicians claimed independent proofs of the Riemann Hypothesis, the most famous open problem in mathematics ( Scientific American ). items.title: How I fight token fraud as a solo founder
items.author: Claire Vo
items.description: Watch now (40 mins) | 🎙️ After losing tens of thousands of dollars to token fraud, I walk through six attack patterns, the defenses I built, and why I killed free trials
items.summary: Today I’m walking you through a problem that has cost me tens of thousands of dollars over the past year and eaten almost all of my engineering energy: token fraud. I’m the solo founder of ChatPRD, a bootstrapped AI platform for product managers, and fraudsters have been farming our free trials, reselling promo codes, wrapping the product in relays, and installing a custom MCP that ran as a 24/7 compute worker.
